name: Eldritch Invocations
description: You have unearthed pieces of forbidden knowledge. You know 1 Eldritch Invocation of your choice, such as Pact of the Tome, which imbues you with an abiding magical ability. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one invocation with another one for which you qualify.

descriptions.2: You have unearthed pieces of forbidden knowledge. You know 3 Eldritch Invocations of your choice, such as Pact of the Tome, which imbues you with an abiding magical ability. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one invocation with another one for which you qualify.
descriptions.3: You have unearthed pieces of forbidden knowledge. You know 3 Eldritch Invocations of your choice, such as Pact of the Tome, which imbues you with an abiding magical ability. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you can replace one invocation with another one for which you qualify.

name: Pact Magic
description: Cast Warlock spells using Charisma. You know 2 cantrips and prepare 2 spells of level 1. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. Replace one prepared spell when you gain a class level. You can use a Arcane Focus as your spellcasting focus.

descriptions.2: Cast Warlock spells using Charisma. You know 2 cantrips and prepare 3 spells of level 1. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. Replace one prepared spell when you gain a class level. You can use a Arcane Focus as your spellcasting focus.
descriptions.3: Cast Warlock spells using Charisma. You know 2 cantrips and prepare 4 spells of level 1 or 2. Spells that a feature always prepares do not count against these choices. Replace one prepared spell when you gain a class level. You can use a Arcane Focus as your spellcasting focus.

name: Dark One's Blessing
description: When you reduce an enemy to 0 HP, or another creature reduces an enemy within 10 feet of you to 0 HP, gain Temporary HP equal to your Charisma modifier + Warlock level (minimum 1).

name: Fiend Spells
description: You always have Burning Hands, Command, Scorching Ray, and Suggestion prepared. These spells do not count against your prepared spell choices.
